$comment: Who gets each kind of task. Each route is a ladder: the conductor starts on the first rung and climbs when a rung keeps failing its gates. The order comes from benchmarks/medellin (Nov 2026): one run per model, so treat it as a prior, not a law, and re-order when runs.jsonl says otherwise. Model names change often; edit them here.

gemini.$settings: Headless mode cannot ask for permission, so any command not allowed here is denied. The list stays narrow: reading files and running the gates.

mechanical.about: Renames, translations, comment passes, tests for existing code, docs. The checks decide, not taste.

ladder.why: 4/4 train in 2 min 13 s with 3.6k output tokens
4/4 train and a recognizable skyline with 14k output tokens

design.about: Pixel art from a photo or description: trains, locomotives, skylines.

ladder.why: 4/4 train, every landmark drawn, 4 min 48 s

research.about: Real-world knowledge: landmarks, vernacular houses, native plants of a region.

ladder.why: named eight real Medellín landmarks and drew seven

bulk.about: Long files, many files, or long text that needs to stay faithful (page translations, sweeping reads).

ladder.why: handled the largest input of the benchmark (3.9M tokens)
